description: Lists the open start times for one service on one date, from the same rules as the operator’s booking page: their hours, breaks, days off, existing bookings and the same-day notice. Each slot has start_time (HH:MM, the operator’s local time), is_after_hours, and the price that applies at that time, which can differ from the list price. An empty list means nothing is open that day.
name: list_availability
title: List open times
